title: Memory Match
description: Flip the cards and find all the matching pairs of cute animals and fruit. A relaxing memory game for kids and grown-ups with three board sizes and a best-score tracker.
instructions: Click or tap a card to flip it over.
Flip a second card — if they match, they stay face up.
Find every pair using as few moves as possible.
Keyboard: use the arrow keys to move and Enter or Space to flip. Press R for a new game.
Use the size button to switch between 4×4, 4×5 and 6×6 boards.
